target.statement: Average Gmean of 93.6±6.4 for REF with default hyperparameters (abs folding, L1/D distance, T=1, J=101) on the Iris1 task (Setosa as target class).
target.table_ref: Table II, row Iris1, column 'abs' under 'Default hyperparams'
target.dataset: Iris (UCI), task Iris1 (Setosa target, 35 training samples, 4 features)

compute.basis: The target is a single small tabular task (150 samples, 4 features) with a simple iterative algorithm (101 iterations of element-wise abs and standardization); the Matlab code is available but would need porting to Python, and the 5 random train-test splits must be recreated.

blockers: Code is in Matlab, not Python; an AI agent would need to reimplement the simple algorithm in Python.
The exact random splits used in the paper are not provided, so the mean and standard deviation may differ slightly from the reported values.
title: Linear-time One-Class Classification with Repeated Element-wise Folding
